guide.summary: Development and testing on demo company (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none); Public app listed in Xero app marketplace (app review).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Development and testing on demo company (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Public app listed in Xero app marketplace (app review).

composio.note: No managed Xero app in Composio; create an auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed Xero app, so you must register your own Xero OAuth app and give Composio its client ID and secret.
reasons: Composio has no managed Xero app
Users should see your app name, not Composio
Dedicated quota instead of shared managed quota
Shorter polling intervals than the 15-minute managed minimum

prerequisites.title: Free Xero developer account
prerequisites.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account first, then register your app to get a client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Demo company or Xero organisation
prerequisites.detail: Develop at no cost using the demo company (recommended) or a trial or paid organisation.

prerequisites.title: 10 qualifying beta customers
prerequisites.detail: They must not be demo companies and must have had API calls in the last 30 days.

steps.title: Sign up for free Xero account
steps.detail: Create the account used to register apps in the Xero developer portal.
steps.done_when: You can log in to the Xero Developer portal

steps.title: Register OAuth 2.0 app in Xero
steps.detail: Register the app to obtain client ID and secret. Register each redirect URI exactly, as wildcards are not allowed.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and client secret

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection succeeds

steps.title: Test against the demo company
steps.detail: Connect and run calls against the demo company before any customers.
steps.done_when: Agent calls succeed on demo data

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare draft answers covering authentication, encryption, personnel security and audit logging.
steps.done_when: Draft answers are ready for your review

steps.title: Apply to App Partner Program
steps.detail: Apply to join the program and start certification. This needs business details and your submission.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Get real customers connected and making API calls before you submit for certification.
steps.done_when: 10 customers with API calls in the last 30 days

steps.title: Wait for Xero security and listing review
steps.detail: Assessment takes about 5 working days, then Xero takes 5-10 working days to assess. Remediation gives 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement.
steps.done_when: Xero confirms you passed and certified

traps.title: Beta customers gate certification
traps.detail: New apps cannot submit the certification application until 10 beta customers are onboarded, and demo companies do not count.

traps.title: Wrong Sign Up with Xero button label
traps.detail: Using the wrong Sign Up or Sign In with Xero label is a common cause of certification delays.

traps.title: Annual repeat of security assessment
traps.detail: You must pass the assessment every year or risk losing certification and listing.

traps.title: No wildcard redirect URIs
traps.detail: Register each callback exactly; up to 50 redirect URIs are allowed.

traps.title: Composio managed app does not exist for Xero
traps.detail: Do not plan around a managed app; users would see Composio branding anyway.

blockers.symptom: Security assessment reports items to fix
blockers.what_it_means: You did not meet the standard on the first pass.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days, then wait for the re-review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan and track the items.

blockers.what_it_means: You cannot submit the certification application yet.
blockers.what_to_do: Onboard real customer organisations with recent API activity.
